note: Derived from Brady, Konkle, Alvarez & Oliva (2008), PNAS 105(38):14325-14329, n=14 observers, 2,500 objects at 3 s each over 5.5 h. The paper's memory test is TWO-ALTERNATIVE FORCED CHOICE, reporting 92.5% (SEM 1.6) novel, 87.6% (SEM 1.8) exemplar, 87.2% (SEM 1.8) state. A 2AFC design has no hit or false-alarm rate, so those cannot be read off it directly. This port is old/new (50 studied + 50 lures), and its lures are procedural variants drawn from the same 768-combination pool as the studied items, which makes Brady's EXEMPLAR condition (a physically similar new object of the same basic-level category) the right analogue rather than NOVEL. Converted with the standard signal-detection identity: d' = sqrt(2) * z(p_2AFC) = 1.634, and for an unbiased old/new test hit = Phi(d'/2) = 0.793, false alarm = 0.207, accuracy = 0.793. SD propagated from the paper's SEM (0.018 * sqrt(14) = 0.067 on the 2AFC scale) through the same transform, giving 0.069. SUPERSEDES the previous values (hit 0.92, accuracy 0.87, false alarm 0.08), which were the novel- and state-condition 2AFC accuracies relabelled as old/new quantities, plus a false-alarm rate of 1 - 0.92 that appears in the paper nowhere. The paper's only genuine hit/false-alarm pair is 96% / 1.3%, from an incidental repeat-detection task during the study phase, not from the memory test. SEARCHED FOR A CLOSER EMPIRICAL MATCH AND FOUND NONE. The Confidence Database (osf.io/s46pr) holds 28 datasets categorised as Memory, and each was checked against this port's design (old/new recognition, 50 studied items and 50 lures drawn from the same 768-combination procedural pool). Kreis_2019, the only one using abstract shapes, is a continuous-report task on a 0-359 degree wheel rather than old/new; Skora_unpub is change detection; the remainder use words, faces, paintings or scenes, whose lure-similarity structure differs from a procedural pool where every lure shares the studied items' feature space. Because lure similarity is what sets old/new difficulty, a dataset matched on response format but not on lure structure would be a worse basis than the present derivation. Brady's EXEMPLAR condition - a physically similar new object of the same basic-level category - remains the closest available analogue, which is why it is the one converted here.
